question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a gold ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a grey ball, Dave has a pink ball, Eve has a blue ball, Fred has a green ball, and Gertrude has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Fred swap balls. Finally, Alice and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) gold ball
(B) white ball
(C) grey ball
(D) pink ball
(E) blue ball
(F) green ball
(G) black ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: gold, white, grey, pink, blue, green, black
1. Claire ↔ Alice: grey, white, gold, pink, blue, green, black
2. Dave ↔ Alice: pink, white, gold, grey, blue, green, black
3. Claire ↔ Dave: pink, white, grey, gold, blue, green, black
4. Claire ↔ Dave: pink, white, gold, grey, blue, green, black
5. Bob ↔ Claire: pink, gold, white, grey, blue, green, black
6. Dave ↔ Fred: pink, gold, white, green, blue, grey, black
7. Alice ↔ Dave: green, gold, white, pink, blue, grey, black
Bob has the gold ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
